title: Cartwise+ Membership Upgrade from a Monthly Plan to Cartwise+ Annual
content:
A Cartwise+ Membership member on a monthly plan who moves up to Cartwise+ Annual pays the upgrade charge, and a new twelve-month period starts on the switch date. The new annual period is billed on its first day at the upgrade charge rather than at Cartwise+ Annual's full period fee.

The upgrade charge on a past-due membership is fixed only after the period being billed shows a captured retry fee and the membership no longer carries a past-due date.

Read against the records: while the membership record still carries a past-due date, or the period being billed shows no captured fee of the renewal-retry type, the upgrade charge of a past-due membership is not yet fixed.

## Effect of the upgrade

| Item | Position |
|---|---|
| Plan afterwards | the annual plan named |
| Plan-switch date | today |
| New period | twelve months, starting today and renewing on the same day a year later (the last day of that month when the day does not exist) |
| Charge | captured from the member's card as the plan-switch fee for the new period |

## Invocation: `upgrade_membership_plan_10b03fa3`

This is an agent-side action: the agent unlocks `upgrade_membership_plan_10b03fa3` and calls it. One call changes the membership's plan to the annual plan named, records today as the date the plan switch took effect, opens a new twelve-month paid period that starts today, and captures the given amount from the member's card as the plan-switch fee for that period. The member sees the new plan, the new renewal date and the plan-switch charge.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the Cartwise+ membership being moved, read from the membership lookup | identifier |
| `variant_name` | the official name of the plan the membership moves to | exactly one of the six values below |
| `amount_usd` | the plan-switch fee captured for the new annual period | USD, a non-negative number with 2 decimal places; more digits are rounded to the nearest cent |

Values of `variant_name`:

| Value | Use with this action |
|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | never used, because it is a monthly plan |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | never used, because it is a monthly plan |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | never used, because it is a monthly plan |
| Cartwise+ Annual | the member moves to the standard annual plan |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | the member moves to the household annual plan |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | the member moves to the top annual plan |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a receipt with `charge_id` (the new fee charge entry's reference number), `membership_id`, `variant_name` (the plan now held), `plan_switched_date` (today), `current_period_start` (today), `current_period_end` (the new renewal date), `amount_usd` (as captured, 2 decimal places) and `status` of `switched`, meaning the membership now stands on the new plan with the charge captured. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. The tool defines no error return.

## Hypothetical renewal dates

| Upgraded on | New renewal date |
|---|---|
| 14 March | 14 March of the next year |
| 29 February | 28 February of the next year |
